note: Prophets dated to reigns of the divided monarchy. 'first'/'last' are the king ORDER numbers within that kingdom's list in kings.json. Datings taken from each book's superscription (or the narrative), verified verbatim against the KJV via the vault ScriptureDatabase. Spans are 'the reigns the text associates with the prophet,' not absolute calendar dates.

prophets.name: Ahijah
prophets.note: Foretold the kingdom's split to Jeroboam.

prophets.name: Elijah
prophets.note: Confronted Ahab, Jezebel, and the Baal cult.

prophets.name: Elisha
prophets.note: Elijah's successor; asked the double portion.

prophets.name: Jonah
prophets.note: Foretold Israel's expansion under Jeroboam II.

prophets.name: Amos
prophets.note: A Judahite herdsman sent to the North's prosperity.

prophets.name: Hosea
prophets.note: The North's last great prophet, into the eve of its fall.

prophets.name: Isaiah
prophets.note: Uzziah to Hezekiah; through the Assyrian crisis.

prophets.name: Micah
prophets.note: Jotham to Hezekiah; contemporary of Isaiah.

prophets.name: Jeremiah
prophets.note: Josiah to Zedekiah; the prophet of the fall.
